children: Weatherford International plc (NASDAQ:WFRD) completed the NCS Multistage takeover—with NCS shares delisted and specific WFRD-share/cash consideration and 357,159 shares registered for resale—while shareholders approved redomestication to the U.S. and the company named Maximiliano Kricorian as CAO.
Weatherford WFRD Acquisition NCS Multistage Completed
: Weatherford (WFRD) closed acquisition of NCS Multistage; NCS shares delisted. Consideration: 0.554 WFRD shares or 0.239 WFRD + cash equal to 0.137 WFRD. 357,159 shares registered for resale.
Weatherford WFRD Redomestication Approved to U.S.
: Weatherford (WFRD) shareholders approved redomestication from Ireland to the U.S.; company will seek High Court of Ireland approval and expects to close the move in Q4 2026, pending court sanction.
Weatherford WFRD Appoints Maximiliano Kricorian CAO
: Weatherford (WFRD) named Maximiliano Kricorian as Senior VP and Chief Accounting Officer, effective upon Mills' departure. Kricorian, a CPA, has held senior finance roles at Weatherford since 2013.
